annotations.title: Send the notetaker to a call

description: Sends the Meetful notetaker to a Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or Webex meeting. It joins as a participant and records; when the call ends, the transcript, recap and action items appear in the signed-in person's dashboard. Requires signing in; usage is counted in minutes per month by plan.

join_at.description: ISO 8601 time to join, for a meeting later today. Omit to join now.

name.description: What the bot is called in the call. Default "Meetful notetaker".

name: send_notetaker
title: Send the notetaker to a call
